events.title: DEMO UPDATE: Spectating, Difficulty Tweaks, Bugfixes
events.summary: Hi folks, Quick update. I've pushed a new patch with a couple new features, and bugfixes. Here's what's new: - SPECTATOR MODE: People were saying that it was a big boring when you are downed and can't do anything until a friend comes to help. So, I've added SPECTATOR MODE. Now, you can toggle between following different players while you are downed. events.title: Gnomads Demo: Now Available!
events.summary: The Gnomads demo is NOW AVAILABLE! Featuring: - 30 unique items to discover - 4 characters with unique abilities. - 10 weapons - The games first level of the game, Skidrock Canyon. - 4 enemy types and a giant beholder boss. Come play, and please don't hesitate to share your feedback by joining our discord and once you play, please drop some feedback here There will be updates and new content dropping in the demo over the next couple weeks, as well as a new trailer and steam page revamp next week

events.title: Demo Launches June 12!
events.summary: The demo for Gnomads launches on June 12!You’ll be able to hop in on June to play the first level of the game and try to beat the boss!What’s in the demo:Desert map + boss with tons of replayability4 unlockable characters30 unique items to collect10 weapons to discoverController + steam deck supportWishlist the game now so you don’t miss it, and come back on June 12 to play the demo.
